title: Cabinet Evidence Event v1
description: One safe, untrusted operational observation in a locally signed and hash-chained trial ledger.

status.$comment: v1.1 vocabulary wave appended the absence statuses missed/skipped/expired (R-2): additive enum widening only, so every stored v1 event still validates. Lockstep with recorder.STATUSES and verifier.STATUSES (one ceremony commit).

component.$comment: version/commit may fall back to the CABINET_BUILD_VERSION/CABINET_GIT_COMMIT environment variables (the recorder's A10 seam): env-derived provenance is UNTRUSTED and never fuel-bearing. Broker-attested provenance rides the reserved detail keys model_id/effort_tier/skill_revision instead.

detail.$comment: Deliberately open (no additionalProperties:false): detail is the additive vocabulary channel, and every value passes bounded redaction before hashing. The v1.1 reserved keys below are optional producer conventions — unlisted keys remain legal, old events without them still validate. Officer visibility is separately allow-listed in the recorder projection (fail-closed drop), and the trust class of every key (producer_asserted vs independently_established) is registered in framework/evidence/classification.py.

parent_trial_id.description: R-3 structured lineage key: trial id of the minting parent, carried in the child trial's genesis event detail. Authoritative over any optional 'evidence-parent:<id>' links[] mirror.

spawned_by.description: Delegation/spawn provenance: component or agent that delegated this work.

delegation_depth.description: Delegation chain depth from the root task (0 = root). Not officer-projected.

scheduled_by.description: Scheduled-trigger provenance: scheduler or service that owned the trigger.

trigger_kind.description: Trigger provenance kind, e.g. cron, launchd, event, manual, retry.

scheduled_for.description: Intended execution time; pairs with the absence statuses missed/skipped/expired. Not officer-projected.

egress_approval_ref.description: Opaque Captain-approval reference id for an external send. Never a URL, email address, or destination handle — destination-shaped values are rewritten by redaction.

input_tokens.description: Cost/resource observation. Producer-asserted; excluded from the officer projection (never-a-score).

output_tokens.description: Cost/resource observation. Producer-asserted; excluded from the officer projection (never-a-score).

cost_usd.description: Finite cost observation (a non-finite producer value is stored as the redaction marker string). Excluded from the officer projection (never-a-score).

resource_kind.description: Resource category, e.g. llm, compute, storage, network. Excluded from the officer projection.

model_id.description: R-4: model identifier sourced from broker/runtime state, never from environment variables. Producer-asserted until broker-attested; never fuel-bearing on its own.

effort_tier.description: R-4: effort tier sourced from broker/runtime state, never env. Producer-asserted. Not officer-projected.

skill_revision.description: R-4: skill/version identifier sourced from runtime state, never env. Producer-asserted.
